# Semgrep rules used by .github/workflows/security.yml (BMM, application code: src-tauri/src, frontend/src, workflows).
#
# Source: https://github.com/semgrep/semgrep-rules at the commit pinned as SEMGREP_RULES_REF in
# security.yml (a84ff9cc2453ca91d581380de4b8b3f272f6f4be, 2026-09-25). One rule file per line,
# relative to that repository; lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Selection: every rule file under the directories below whose rules are NOT tagged
# `subcategory: audit`. Audit rules flag every use of a sink (each innerHTML, each temp_dir)
# for a human to review; on this codebase they produced 3,700 hits, 1,480 of them at ERROR, with
# no way to tell a real one from the rest. They belong in a manual review, not a CI gate.
# To regenerate after bumping the pin, see "Semgrep rules" in the Security CI docs.
#
# Directories: rust/lang/security, javascript/lang/security, javascript/browser/security, yaml/github-actions/security
